plang/programming-fundamentals/1-1-terms.comment: The document provides a clean, well-structured, and highly readable introduction to essential software development terms using clear comparative tables and flow summaries. However, it functions predominantly as a passive glossary, lacking interactive cognitive prompts and deeper theoretical exploration into low-level execution mechanics. To fully align with the LIQUID framework, it needs to incorporate active inquiry elements and bridge basic terminology with advanced system-level concepts.
